stack.language: JavaScript (jsconfig.json, @/* alias); TypeScript to be added for kx chassis + templates
stack.styling: hand-authored CSS (globals.css tokens + [data-theme] theming, landing.css, blog.css, studio.css); Google Fonts; custom cursor

i18n.mechanism: lib/i18n.js single I18N const; leaves are {es,en,ja} (strings, string[] for lists, and arrays-of-objects with mixed localized/plain fields). lib/lang.js useLang() is useState('es') + localStorage['kimox-lang'] — the useState trap.
i18n.strategy: 1 (localized-leaf schemas). Rebuild useLang as a module-level external store (useSyncExternalStore + localStorage + listener set, SAME public API [lang,setLang]) BEFORE porting sections, so the nav switcher drives every independently-mounted template. Define localized/localizedList Zod helpers. Transcribe values verbatim (typos and all).
i18n.gap: F: kimox-fw has no first-class localization story (framework-limit).

routes.notes: Custom magazine landing. ~10 bespoke sections, each ported as a project-local template emitting the original class names. Nav (lang switch + theme toggle) ported as site-nav node. Contact keeps the submitContact server action. app/page.jsx deleted in content phase; catch-all becomes optional [[...slug]].

Collection index derived live from posts.js (featured/others + client category filter). Hand-authored entry-list would desync from the .md source of truth. Kept as dynamic route. Gap: no collection/query primitive.

7 posts, each with {es,en,ja} markdown bodies rendered via react-markdown. No markdown/prose template exists to hold them losslessly. Skill explicitly blesses island for rich per-language markdown. Gap: no markdown-body template.
Custom password-gated internal CMS (social-post planner: kanban, calendar, PNG export). Application behavior, not content. Untouched.
PATCH/DELETE studio post by id. Untouched.

'use server' submitContact: zod validate + honeypot + timing gate + upstash rate limit + Resend email (console fallback). Kept as server action, bound to the ported contact-section template's client form. Env: RESEND_API_KEY, RESEND_FROM, RESEND_TO, UPSTASH_*.

Decap CMS (CDN SPA, GitHub backend) backing content/posts + studio.json. Live. Kept. NOTE: this /admin path collides with the kimox-fw admin SPA mount — mount the kx admin at a different path (e.g. /kx-admin) to avoid clobbering Decap. See chassis phase.

gaps_note: Updated after discovering the framework already ships localization helpers (localized/localizedList/resolveLocalized), createClientStore, prose, and collection-list — so the phase-2 gaps were reframed to the REMAINING limitations. report.html is authoritative.

gaps.notes: Localization primitives exist (localized/localizedList/resolveLocalized + createClientStore) but there is no built-in language store/switcher or locale-aware admin preview; each site hand-wires its own lang store (here kx/stores.ts + rewritten lib/lang.js) and the admin shows all N language fields per text.

collection-list auto-derives rows from docs under a route prefix but reads single-language meta.title/description only, with no featured/category facets — the trilingual blog with featured+filter can't use it losslessly, so /blog stayed an island.
prose renders a single markdown string; no localized-markdown variant for {es,en,ja} bodies, so blog posts stayed islands.

Admin mount convention (/admin) collides with an existing Decap /admin; no documented admin-base-path config. Mounted kx admin at /kx-admin manually (API stays at /api/kx/* which the admin client hardcodes — fine).
page chrome:'none' still emits a <main> wrapper; a site whose original had no wrapper must override the page component to a bare fragment (done here).
renderPageFromContent exposes no document meta to generateMetadata, so per-page <title>/description from the document aren't applied; layout metadata is the only lever.
@kx/nextjs peers are next ^14||^15; Next 16 builds/runs only with --webpack (Turbopack can't resolve link: deps) and middleware.ts warns (deprecated for proxy.ts). Handled via webpack-pinned scripts.
